content.value_statement: Revenue teams lose pipeline when lifecycle stages, scoring, routing, and handoffs are unclear. This skill creates practical RevOps frameworks, CRM workflow guidance, and metrics for stronger marketing-to-sales execution.
actual_capabilities: Defines lead lifecycle stages with owners, entry criteria, exit criteria, and handoff SLAs.
Builds lead scoring models using fit, engagement, negative signals, and MQL thresholds.
Designs routing rules for round-robin, territory, account-based, and skill-based assignment.
Outlines CRM automation workflows for alerts, tasks, recycling, stale deals, and digests.
Specifies RevOps dashboards for marketing, sales, and executive metrics.
limitations: Provides guidance and specifications, but does not connect to CRM APIs or change records directly.
Requires CRM, funnel, ACV, sales cycle, and stack details for precise recommendations.
Benchmarks and thresholds need validation against the user's historical conversion data.
Does not replace legal, finance, or compliance review for deal desk rules.

use_cases.title: Repair Marketing-to-Sales Handoffs
use_cases.description: Map lifecycle stages, define SLAs, and create clear acceptance rules for MQL and SQL transitions.

use_cases.title: Create Lead Scoring Rules
use_cases.description: Build fit and engagement scoring that separates real buying intent from low-value activity.

use_cases.title: Document Pipeline Governance
use_cases.description: Define pipeline stages, required fields, stale deal alerts, and dashboard metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Audit My Lead Lifecycle
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my current lifecycle stages and recommend MQL, SQL, and opportunity definitions. Ask for missing context before finalizing the model.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Lead Scoring Model
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a lead scoring model for a B2B SaaS company with [ACV], [ICP], [sales cycle], and [CRM]. Include fit, engagement, negative signals, and an MQL threshold.

prompt_templates.title: Design Routing and SLAs
prompt_templates.prompt: Design routing rules for [segments], [territories], [rep roles], and [monthly lead volume]. Include fallback owners, missed-SLA escalation, and reporting fields.

prompt_templates.title: Create an End-to-End RevOps Blueprint
prompt_templates.prompt: Produce a full RevOps operating plan for [business model]. Include lifecycle definitions, scoring, routing, CRM automation, pipeline governance, dashboards, and rollout risks.

output_examples.input: I need a lead scoring model for a $10K ACV SaaS company.
output: Fit score based on company size, industry, role, and firmographic match.
Engagement score based on demo requests, pricing visits, webinars, and product activity.
Negative scoring for competitors, students, spam complaints, and poor data quality.
Recommended MQL threshold with a quarterly recalibration process.

output_examples.input: Our MQLs are not getting worked by sales.
output: A handoff SLA with response time, acceptance criteria, rejection reasons, and escalation rules.
A routing model with fallback owners and audit logging for every assignment.
A dashboard view for speed-to-lead, acceptance rate, and stale MQL volume.

output_examples.input: We need executive visibility into pipeline health.
output: A dashboard structure covering lead-to-MQL rate, pipeline velocity, CAC, LTV:CAC, and win rate.
Separate marketing, sales, and executive views with clear data sources.
Recommended benchmarks and review cadence for revenue team meetings.

best_practices: Define lifecycle stages and acceptance criteria before building automation.
Validate scoring thresholds with closed-won and closed-lost data.
Log routing decisions and SLA misses for ongoing process improvement.
anti_patterns: Do not treat every content download as buying intent.
Do not automate a handoff process before teams agree on definitions.
Do not rely on dashboards when required CRM fields are incomplete.

faq.question: What RevOps problems does this skill handle?
faq.answer: It handles lifecycle design, lead scoring, routing, CRM workflows, pipeline hygiene, deal desk process, and revenue metrics.

faq.question: Does it update HubSpot or Salesforce directly?
faq.answer: No. It provides implementation-ready guidance, but it does not connect to CRM systems or modify records.

faq.question: Can it help define an MQL?
faq.answer: Yes. It combines fit, engagement, negative scoring, and sales acceptance rules to define practical MQL criteria.

faq.question: What context should I provide first?
faq.answer: Provide your GTM motion, ACV, sales cycle, CRM, lead volume, current lifecycle stages, and main bottleneck.

faq.question: Is it useful for PLG motions?
faq.answer: Yes. It can include product usage signals, PQL handoffs, self-serve activity, and hybrid sales triggers.

faq.question: Can it create dashboards?
faq.answer: It can specify dashboard views, metrics, formulas, data sources, and review cadence for RevOps reporting.
